children: ProFrac amended its Alpine Term Loan Credit Agreement to extend maturity to February 15, 2030, introduce a 12-month 675 bps payment-in-kind interest option, reduce near-term amortization, and implement a 100% excess cash flow sweep. Concurrently, the company enabled the repayment and cancellation of $60 million of affiliate-held 2026 Term Loans by transferring 2,306,806 Flotek shares to the affiliate lenders, resulting in full payoff and release of related guarantees. Together, the steps enhance liquidity, defer cash outlays, and streamline ProFrac's capital structure.
